item.title: ISSS Hosts Free Immigration Workshop by NPZ Law Group
item.description: ISSS will host a virtual workshop presented by NPZ Group (Nachman, Phulwani, Zimovcak (NPZ) Law Group, P.C.). Hear from expert immigration lawyers about the visa options after graduation, including H-1B, O-1, and much more! Online event on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 from 2:30 p.m. - 3:50 p.m. Register at: https://tinyurl.com/NPZ-workshop-FA26
item.author: Community

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Seminar – “Certifications & Skill Development in Percipio”
item.description: Date: Thursday, November 5, 2026 1:00 PM - Fri , November 6, 2026 7:00 PM - This course introduces the tools available in Percipio to support growth through certifications and skill benchmarks. You’ll learn how to identify relevant certifications and use benchmark assessments to measure current knowledge. Perfect for employees and supervisors alike, this session will help you navigate the platform’s upskilling features and align learning with career development objectives.

item.title: DCC Walkway and Underpass Reopened
item.description: The upper walkway and the underpass on the DCC side have reopened for pedestrian access. The campus community may now cross over the walkway and walk underneath. Please note that these areas will close again at the end of November to allow for the installation of the stairs and column. Thank you for your continued patience and cooperation as this project nears completion.
item.author: Community

item.title: Authentication Infrastructure Upgrades
item.description:
DotCIO will be performing planned authentication infrastructure upgrades on Wednesday, November 4. No user impact is expected, but we are sharing this notice so the campus community is aware of the work. If you experience any authentication or access issues, please submit a ticket at support.rpi.edu.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
